HRA Analysis: MYTHICAL DRAGON (4) dominated in a recent trial running out a big winner over lesser opposition. He does have good gate speed and may be looking to hold the early advantage in this race over Skip To Me Lou who looks the biggest danger. SKIP TO ME LOU (5) trialled up extremely well for a one win horse when finishing third behind FFA pacer Captain Shuffles who is set to line up a clear second favourite this Saturday behind the champion Leap To Fame. The draw looks awkward but he cant be ruled out of his recent trial. ATULA (3) appeared to have good gate speed in her trial prior to debuting when beating Ultimate Ark. She was well beaten on debut in the state but did take on a strong race taken out by Barracuda. OH HERESHE COMES (1) should have the speed to drive through and settle in a prominent position in the early stages. She got back and couldn’t get into the race last time out which was taken out by King Bling over the 2138 at this track. SELECTIONS: MYTHICAL DRAGON (4),SKIP TO ME LOU (5), ATULA (3), OH HERESHE COMES (1) SUGGESTED BET: MYTHICAL DRAGON (4) to win.

BUSTER DAN (5) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and was running on nicely late into second behind Dingane. He should settle close again in the run and can be hard to hold out late in this race. CROOKWELL EYES (6) has made a break in his latest two outings but does usually step well from the stand and should make light work of his 20m handicap. If he can settle close enough it looks a suitable race for him to bounce back in. BLACK VIPER (8) should get a good run off the speed in this race. He was an impressive winner in this race three starts ago when running right over the top to score well. ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (3) secured a good run just behind the speed three starts ago and was running on into second behind key rival BLACK VIPER (8). With a safe beginning she looks suited in this race starting off 10n. SELECTIONS: BUSTER DAN (5), CROOKWELL EYES (6), BLACK VIPER (8), ITS ALL RIGHT NOW (3) SUGGESTED BET: BUSTER DAN (5) to win.

HARRY KANE (2) secured a good run on the pegs last time out when returning from a spell and was running on well late once clear to get into third. He draws more favourably this time in a slightly weaker race and should be hard to hold out late. BETTOR CHEER (6) bounced back to nearer his better form last time out when running on well into fifth behind BetterthanFederer in a stronger race. He may need some luck in running from his wide draw and can be hard to beat in this race. JAY TEE TYRON (4) got back in the run last time out in a race taken out by Its Back Page News and was making up some ground late. He might be shuffled back again in this race and can be running on late. SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (1) set a very slow tempo over the 2138 at this track and was able to hold them off late. He may be better suited back in trip and did put in a good run last time out. SELECTIONS: HARRY KANE (2), BETTOR CHEER (6), JAY TEE TYRON (4), SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (1) SUGGESTED BET: HARRY KANE (2) to win.

RACANA (2) should have the speed to drive through and lead in this race and was a good winner rating fast time three starts ago at this track and trip. She ran well again last start when getting into seventh behind Fire Raiser beaten just 5.4m. MISTER SEASIDE (8) draws to have options in this race being the only horse drawn on the back row. Secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on well late into third behind the smart Captain Jazz. OPALLANE (3) secured a good run off the speed last time out and ran on well into third behind Sheer vitality. He draws reasonably in this race and should settle close enough to play a part in the finish. MY ULTIMATE MARIO (1) secured a good run on the pegs last time out behind Francs For Coming and was able to battle away well there for second. He should secure a similar run in this race and should be thereabouts the placings. SELECTIONS: RACANA (2), MISTER SEASIDE (8), OPALLANE (3), MY ULTIMATE MARIO (1) SUGGESTED BET: RACANA (2) to win.

ALTA SENSATION (2) has good gate speed and may be able to work to the lead in the early stages of this race. He has been in excellent form scoring a good win last time out rating fast time out at Redcliffe when leading all the way there. DUAL CAM (1) draws well in this race and should settle close in the run. He handed over the lead last time out before running home reasonably late into fifth behind Loch Lamond. He should get every chance. PUMPKIN PAT (8) should get a good run through in this race and should get a very economical run on the pegs. She was able to bounce back nicely doing some early work and scoring a dominant win at Redcliffe. She can be dangerous late. CHARGE AHEAD (4) appears to drop in a grade a touch off some of his recent outings. He likely wasn’t suited when getting back last time out and making a wide run into it late behind Our Rocky when finishing ninth. SELECTIONS: ALTA SENSATION (2), DUAL CAM (1), PUMPKIN PAT (8), CHARGE AHEAD (4) SUGGESTED BET: ALTA SENSATION (2) to win.

ROSIE POLLEN (6) was able to zip across last time out and was forced to do some work there before being run down by Sports Bounty who obtained the leaders back trail. She should be able to get forward again in this race and if she found the lead she would likely take plenty of running down. THE REAL ROCKETMAN (3) has early speed and should settle close enough in the run in this race. Didn’t race without a lot of luck last time out at this track when getting back on the pegs and running on late into fourth. SKYLAR BREE (2) was forced to do some work last time out when battling on well for third behind Party Changer. If she could work onto the pegs early she would likely have good place claims in a race of this nature. MAYWYNS KAREN (8) draws behind a horse without a lot of gate speed which looks a touch awkward. She was able to find the pegs recently at this track over the 2138 and just came up short behind stablemate Smirks Lika Boss. SELECTIONS: ROSIE POLLEN (6), THE REAL ROCKETMAN (3), SKYLAR BREE (2), MAYWYNS KAREN (8) SUGGESTED BET: ROSIE POLLEN (6) to win.

IDEAL PURSUIT (1) led last time out at this track and trip and was run down late by KING BLING (10) and All Eyes On Bling. She did set a genuine enough tempo in that race and if she is able to control things out in front she should get hard to run down in this field. OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (8) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader in this race. She secured a good run recently at Redcliffe when finishing second to Sheer Vitality. ROLL TO THE TOP (2) is having her first start at Albion Park in this race having had 10 starts so far in QLD all at Redcliffe. She was good three starts ago running on strongly behind My Ultimate Victor. KING BLING (10) was an impressive winner recently at this track and trip running over the top to score. He is likely to get back in the run again in this race and should be finishing it off well late. SELECTIONS: IDEAL PURSUIT (1), OUR ULTIMATE MILLY (8), ROLL TO THE TOP (2), KING BLING (10) SUGGESTED BET: ROLL TO THE TOP (2) to win. OVERVIEW: BLUE MIKI (2) has been in fantastic form recently after a run of placings, and he got back into the winner’s circle last start after leading at Melton. He’s a versatile horse, but his gate speed should allow him to find the front again here. SPEEDY HEALEY (5) is also in great form and has the best sectional times in this event. He won well last start at Geelong, but he does have a challenging barrier to overcome here. STERLING GIGI (9) is a two-year-old who is racing better than his numerical form suggests. He’s been racing through the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series, where he finished fifth in both his heat and semi-final before finishing sixth in the final. He has ability and a good barrier to follow through early, but he is a young horse taking on older horses here. WINGATE GUY (1) hit the line brilliantly last start to get back into the winner’s circle and finds the ideal barrier to map well again here. BACK: BLUE MIKI (2)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BLUE MIKI (2), SPEEDY HEALEY (5), STERLING GIGI (9), WINGATE GUY (1)

OVERVIEW: SPUN SILVER (5) is a flashy, high-speed grey mare who is in great form, finishing in the top three at her last five starts. The first few hundred metres will be important here as she has great gate speed, but so does IAMAWINGATE (4), who is drawn inside her, although he hasn’t shown his gate speed much recently. If she does get caught in the breeze, she could be vulnerable over the middle-distance trip. MIKI MARK (9) has a barrier to follow through here and get into the running line comfortably. He’s racing well and has the best sectional times in this event. FOUR EVER A STAR (3) is having her fourth start back after three years on the sidelines. She has improved with each start back, running home well last start to be beaten only 3.7 metres. Her fitness and confidence should be good here, and we are likely to see another improved performance. IAMAWINGATE (4) is racing OK and has the gate speed to map well here. He did it tough last start at Stawell but fought on well for third. Also respecting TREACHEROUSTIMES (10) here, but he has a tricky barrier. SELECTIONS: SPUN SILVER (5),MIKI MARK (9), FOUR EVER A STAR (3),IAMAWINGATE (4).

OVERVIEW: NO MONEY NO HONEY (5) is a very talented mare, but her manners are poor more often than not. She won a Trotting Mares Free For All two starts ago at Melton when she was on her best behaviour. She needs to trot here. KEAYANG MINNESOTA (2) is a smart mare who can sometimes gallop, but there is no doubt she has the ability to be competitive in this field. If she trots safely, she can make her presence felt. KITTY CASH (4) is a progressive trotter who keeps getting better with each start. She has proven she can make her own luck and win well. This looks to be one of her toughest tests, but she continues to rise to the occasion. ALECTRONA (1) is a lightly raced trotter who has been solid and competitive in most of her runs. She broke through for her maiden victory last start very impressively. She is on the up. SELECTIONS:NO MONEY NO HONEY (5), KEAYANG MINNESOTA (2), KITTY CASH (4), ALECTRONA (1)

OVERVIEW: WAZZANT ME (3) is an interesting performer. He has good trial form, but his manners were a query in his one career start. He was very green and not tractable. That was in July, and he’s been back to the trials since, where he performed well. We will learn more about him here, but he needs to bring his best behaviour. DYGANALI (6) has been racing well. She had a tough run last start, while her two runs prior were competitive placings. She has a tricky barrier, but a win wouldn’t surprise. CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (2) has the best figure form in this event, placing a few times recently. He flashed home nicely last start at Cranbourne, but it was his run at Maryborough three starts back that really caught my eye. He flew home from last to be beaten by only a narrow margin and looks to be working towards his maiden victory. Similarly to WAZZANT ME (3), JILLIBY ECLIPSE (4) has struggled with her manners in her two career starts. However, her trials have been good. She needs to pace throughout, but she has the ability to be competitive if she puts it all together. SELECTIONS:WAZZANT ME (3), DYGANALI (6), CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (2), JILLIBY ECLIPSE (4)

OVERVIEW: ROCKNROLL RAMBO (6) moved to Victoria in July and seems to be getting better with each start. Two starts ago, he got into third after settling last, and then last start he worked to find the front and was only narrowly beaten late. He has proven he’s versatile with his race map, which is a big advantage from the tricky barrier. GOZO MAJOR (11) has the best sectional times in this field. He is tough and can do plenty of work in his races, although he did seem a little below his best last start. He will need to make his own luck from barrier 11. TOPZAVSKI (1) is first-up here but gets the ace barrier, which should give him a good trip. DELTA STARZ (9) has been racing better than her numerical form suggests. Last start, she didn’t have the clearest running late but was letting down nicely. She should get a good trip here and be saved for one run. BACK: ROCKNROLL RAMBO (2)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ROCKNROLL RAMBO (6), GOZO MAJOR (11), TOPZAVSKI (1), DELTA STARZ (9)

OVERVIEW: MONEY TALKS (6) has been racing consistently well. Although beaten 22.3 metres last start, it wasn’t a bad run and he was racing in a much tougher field than this one. He has the best sectional times in this event. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (9) performs well and has a nice turn of foot when he gets things right. Barrier nine should suit him here as he has space to settle early. MAJOR MAX (5) is a trotter you need to take on trust. When he gets things right, he performs well. If he trots throughout here, he is a winning chance. BET BET HOTSHOT (7) got back into the winner’s circle last week after getting a perfect fence trip and running home well late. He’s racing in good form, but barrier seven will make it hard for him. BACK: MONEY TALKS (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:MONEY TALKS (6), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (9), MAJOR MAX (5), BET BET HOTSHOT (7)

OVERVIEW: This is a very strong race with some nice mares. SHARP INTEREST (2) is a talented type with a great turn of foot. The way she let down two starts ago at Wagga was outstanding. This is a tough race, but she gets the barrier advantage here. SHES ALLABOUTLUV (5) is one of the best mares from Tasmania, and her record speaks for itself. She got well back in her Vicbred Super Series heat last start and couldn’t make ground into the race. She will improve from that run. IDEAL MOTH (3) is a proven talented mare at her best. There are a few question marks over where she is at currently, but she will be competitive here. DELIGHTFUL MIKI (8) was held up and let down very well in her Vicbred Super Series heat and seemed unlucky not to make the final. She is a talented mare, and being the only horse on the back row, she has some map options. KEAYANG VIPER (7) is a smart mare in great form who is lightly raced. However, she has a challenging barrier here against a strong field of mares, and this is her toughest test. BACK: SHARP INTEREST (2)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:SHES ALLABOUTLUV (5), SHARP INTEREST (2), DELIGHTFUL MIKI (8), IDEAL MOTH (3)

OVERVIEW: KIMBERLEYS TREE (8) has her quirks, but she also has plenty of ability. She galloped out last start and charged home into second, even after missing away by a few lengths. Being the only horse on the second line, she has space and time to settle early. If she trots throughout, she will be hard to beat. I AM HARRO (3) is a nice trotter when he brings his best. I can’t leave him out of a race like this one. MASSIF CENTRAL (1) is in good form, winning last start after getting a fence trip. He is likely to map similarly here. KYVALLEY MISTY (6) has had issues with her manners throughout her career, but she’s putting it together now and is in career-best form. Also respecting VAN DOREN (2) and JESSICAS STORY (4) here. BACK: KIMBERLEYS TREE (8) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:KIMBERLEYS TREE (8), I AM HARRO (3), MASSIF CENTRAL (1), KYVALLEY MISTY (6)

OVERVIEW: ZIPPIN PAST (8) is a smart two-year-old filly taking on the older horses here. She usually uses her fast gate speed to map positively, but she won’t be able to do that from barrier eight, so we will see a different racing style from her here. She has a great turn of foot and was third last start in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series Final. DONA AMALIA (6) is better than her recent numerical form suggests. She has had a run of bad luck or poor manners, but she is a very fast mare who has the ability to make her own luck and race tough. CARTACALHA (5) has shown promise throughout her career. She did underperform last start, but likely had excuses. She’s a winning chance here at her best. CHRISTMAS BABE (1) is a ten-year-old mare with great gate speed who likes to lead. Her fitness is a query here as she is first-up. SELECTIONS:ZIPPIN PAST (8), DONA AMALIA (6), CARTACALHA (5), CHRISTMAS BABE (1)

OVERVIEW: This is a nice field of trotters to end the card. MUSKEE (6) was slightly below his best late last start in his Vicbred Super Series heat, although he did get a long way back in a tough field when they ran home in quick time. He is a very nice trotter who looks like he will continue to progress through his grades. His win four starts ago at Melton was outstanding when he sustained a long run. At his best, he’s a talented and versatile trotter. CLAUDYS HERO (2) is a talented trotter with a bright future, but he can get it wrong with his manners. He galloped last start in his Vicbred Super Series heat. He does have the gate speed to map well here and, if he finds the fence, he will be hard to run down. VOLDAGHA (3) is another promising trotter who can perform well at his best. He is first-up here. KYVALLEY JAGGER (1) gets the ace barrier to use to his advantage here, and he’s racing well when he trots throughout. Also keeping an eye on THATS MY CARDIGAN (5), who does have a nice turn of foot and good gate speed, but this is a tough step up. SELECTIONS:MUSKEE (6), CLAUDYS HERO (2), VOLDAGHA (3), KYVALLEY JAGGER (1) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

A maiden for two and three-year-old fillies kicks off tonight, where BETTYS GIRL (3) looks to have the best of the exposed form. She produced a nice third on debut earlier this year after showing gate speed and, while she hasn't trialled since, that form would be hard to beat here. Her stablemate CHASING THE ACE (4) was a trial winner last week and looks the best of the debutants. RAZZAMATAZ (1) is an extremely well-bred filly out of the smart mare Benediction and is a half-sister to Inter Dominion placegetter Nyack. She ran an okay second in a trial a month ago and you'd expect she has come on since then, so betting may be the best guide. FARRAHS LEGACY (2) is the other two-year-old on debut and has been hit and miss with its manners at the trials, making it somewhat hard to gauge. BELLAS ANGEL (5) is the most experienced horse in the field with four starts and has improved at her past two starts against older horses, so must also be considered. Selections:BETTYS GIRL (3), CHASING THE ACE (4), RAZZAMATAZ (1), BELLAS ANGEL (5)

A small but competitive field for the No More Than Four Wins horses, where OUR WILLOW (1) gets the pole draw and produced a nice effort first up for the new stable. She possesses good gate speed, although suspect she may take a sit on WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2), who won in fast time over the mile last start and is a super-consistent pacer. ROCKY STRIDE (4) has been racing well without winning and should again be right in the finish after competing in some handy three-year-old races of late. BEARHUNTA (5) went around as favourite last week but broke on the first turn. He clearly possesses plenty of ability if he brings his best manners here. DENVER MAN (6) won impressively first up in the state when doing all the work in okay time. This is a slight rise in grade, but he certainly can't be discounted. Selections:OUR WILLOW (1), ROCKY STRIDE (4), WEE GEORGIE WOOD (2), , BEARHUNTA (5)

CUZZY BRO (1) led against most of these runners last start and was simply too good in exceptional time, despite not being favoured in the market. A similar run from the pole draw again should see him extremely hard to beat. BETTABLACK TIGER (3) tried to make ground from back in the field in that race and battled on okay. GO THE RED (6) should again be right in the finish, especially if he can secure some cover into the race, having been super consistent of late. WATERMELON SUGAR (4) and VANQUISH STRIDE (5) have been filling the placings in similar-class races and should be thereabouts again, although it is hard to see them beating the favoured runners. Selections:CUZZY BRO (1), BETTABLACK TIGER (3) , GO THE RED (6), WATERMELON SUGAR (4)

A couple of handy three-year-olds in JILLSTIGER (1) and A DRAGON FOR JOE (3) take on the older horses here, along with SOHO TIGER LILY (2), who possesses sharp gate speed and should be looking to be first to the pegs. She should be well suited by the mile distance. OUR SWEET TRIXIE (4) showed good gate speed to lead and win in nice time last start and will no doubt again press forward from the middle front-row draw. TALK IS CHEAP (6) and GOBSMACKED (8) will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to finish home strongly and get into the finish. Selections: A DRAGON FOR JOE (3), JILLSTIGER (1), GOBSMACKED (8), OUR SWEET TRIXIE (4)

A full field assembles for the No More Than One Lifetime Win race, where QUARTEIRA (12) starts from the outside draw after causing a false start in the score-up last time. He clearly has untapped ability and, although he faces a difficult draw, the 2200-metre journey should give him the opportunity to show his class. If he brings his best behaviour, he will be hard to hold out late. The remainder looks a fairly even bunch, with WINNING BREW (5) producing nice performances at its past two starts that are good enough to see her run a race again, although she strikes an awkward draw. SWEETHEART DIOR (4) is in a similar boat and will no doubt be looking to find a forward position. OMYBACNKNEESJUDGE (10) have been consistent of late from favourable front-row draws. It would be somewhat surprising to see the others take this out, with the exception of SNIPER SANZ (11), who resumes from a long break and did show some nice ability at times as a two-year-old. Selections:QUARTEIRA (12), WINNING BREW (5), SWEETHEART DIOR (4), SNIPER SANZ (11)

There should be speed aplenty here, with numerous fast beginners drawn across the front row. WEONA EAGLE (1) draws the pole so should find a nice position in the run. KEEPERS IDEAL (6), MUZZAME MATE (4), MIGHT AND TEMERITY (3) and INTO THE HARKNESS (2) should all look to push forward from their front-row draws, which should ensure a solid tempo throughout. It's a very hard race to assess, where the runner that gets the nicest run in transit may ultimately be the one to beat. IDEN LADY LINCOLN (7) could be the one to benefit if she brings her best form after producing a nice trial ahead of her return, and should be running home strongly. Selections:IDEN LADY LINCOLN (7), WEONA EAGLE (1), MUZZAME MATE (4), KEEPERS IDEAL (6)

TAMBROS TILLY (7) was an impressive winner last start after settling midfield, but draws the outside of the front row here, which makes her task harder in what looks a very even field overall. GOODTIME OSCAR (9) is a consistent pacer and gets a nice trailing back-row draw, which should give him every opportunity. WILL HE PIKE (5) may look to use his handy gate speed to attempt to find the pegs, or at least secure a forward position from the middle front-row draw. LYNRYD SKYNRYD (6) will no doubt press forward from the gate but hasn't been finishing his races off as well of late. MERRYWOOD PAUL (1) should appreciate stepping back up to the middle-distance journey and is going better than his form suggests, so he could be the one from the nice draw if the gaps appear late. Selections:TAMBROS TILLY (7), GOODTIME OSCAR (9), MERRYWOOD PAUL (1), WILL HE PIKE (5)

The low-class race of the night brings together a field with no clear standout form. ALL ABOUT SADIE (1) again draws well courtesy of having just the one lifetime win and should get every chance if the gaps appear late. DANCINWIVJOLENE (3) resumes from a break but has shown enough ability at times to suggest that, at her best, she could take this out. MIKI SANZ (6) drops back in grade after being thereabouts of late without having much luck in her races, although she again strikes an awkward draw. CHRIS BE QUICK (9) gets the nice trailing back-row draw and is always capable of running home strongly, so could be the one they have to hold out late. Selections:ALL ABOUT SADIE (1), DANCINWIVJOLENE (3), MIKI SANZ (6), CHRIS BE QUICK (9)

There should be some good gate speed and a genuine tempo early over the mile, with JUST LIKA DREAM (4) looking to hold a forward position while trying to hold out IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (5) and REPETITIVE (6), who are both sharp off the gate when asked. IMA LITTLE NEEDY (1) has been below his best of late but could improve significantly from the pole draw, and his best form would make him hard to beat here. ROSE NOIRE (8) will need some luck to come her way but got a deserved victory on the board last start and should again be thereabouts. Selections:JUST LIKE A DREAM (4), IFYOULOVEMELETMEGO (5), IMA LITTLE NEEDY (1), ROSE NOIRE (8) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:ALL DONE TARA (3) settled ninth on the markers and held her ground over the latter stages when sixth in the Super Series Silver event at Melton last week. She has been placed in all of her three starts at Mildura previously and this is a decent drop back in class so she should prove hard to beat. WHITEHAVEN BEACH (1) worked forward to find the lead from a wide draw when he won at Mildura on August 14. He went very hard in the early stages and had excuses last outing so he is worth thought from the pole position. CARLISLE CRUISER (7) hasn’t been at his best form since resuming but he should be building on his fitness and he has the perfect trailing draw behind a fast beginner so he is worth a ticket each way. CAULONIA TERRA (5) and SHIRLEY NOT (8) were both successful against slightly easier opposition last week and are not without a chance. SELECTIONS: ALL DONE TARA (3), WHITEHAVEN BEACH (1), CARLISLE CRUISER (7), CAULONIA TERROR (5)

OVERVIEW:MAJOR LINCOLN (4) finished quickly from a rearward position when an eye-catching second behind Keayang Crippa then followed with a good victory at Stawell. He is racing in peak form and should prove hard to beat again. HESASTAR (1) pushed forward to find the lead and dominated his rivals last week. This race is a little harder but he is drawn to find the lead again so he should go well. NEDS BEACH (7) gained the perfect trip and finished off best to win at Mildura last week. He is drawn to obtain a similar economical run behind HESASTAR (1) and should be competitive again. LIKE A LIBRARIAN (9) has found the line strongly in all of his three starts since coming from New South Wales. He is a Maiden taking on proven winners but he must be respected. SELECTIONS: MAJOR LINCOLN (4), HESASTAR (1), NEDS BEACH (7), LIKE A LIBRARIAN (9)

OVERVIEW: WHITEHAVEN BOY (6) is dropping back from the Group 1 Super Series Final into this Maiden event so it is a huge drop back in class. He finished ninth in the Final but he did draw on the outside of the second line and the winner Some High recorded a fast mile rate of 1.56.0 (2240m). EDGAR BROMAC (2) gained a nice trail and finished third in slick time on debut then followed with an unplaced run in the Super Series Silver event, where he used a lot of energy at the start. He is likely to give a forward showing from his good draw. LARACHA (8) was three back on the markers throughout when a distant third in the Super Series Silver event. She has the perfect trailing draw and must be considered as a winning chance against this class. LATHER WITH FIRE (10) didn’t have much luck when fourth on debut then was spelled. She has ability and is capable of running into a place despite the poor draw. BACK: WHITEHAVEN BOY (6) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: WHITEHAVEN BOY (6), EDGAR BROMAC (2), LARACHA (8), LATHER WITH FIRE (10)

OVERVIEW: It is an open race with many winning chances. NEATNTIDY (4) is resuming since April but he was very competitive against the Metropolitan class during his last preparation and he should take beating if he is somewhere near his peak. He did record a mile rate of 1.58.1 when he won a trial at Stawell last week. RUFF NUT (6) was placed at his only start at Mildura previously and will find this race to be easier than his latest unplaced performances. He is widely drawn but is very durable and should be competitive against this class. LEWIELEWIS (3) bounced back into form with an impressive win at Mildura last week, where he came out very wide on the home turn and produced a powerful finishing burst. This is a race of more depth but he is worth thought again. MODERN GINGER (2) is resuming but has the early speed to be prominent throughout. KYORETSU (5) has been in winning form and has claims along with CEMETERY BAY (7), which has been finishing strongly at his most recent Mildura appearances. SELECTIONS: NEATNTIDY (4), RUFF NUT (6), LEWIELEWIS (3), MODERN GINGER (2)

OVERVIEW:MY ULTIMATE BILLY (5) appears to be very well graded in this event and gets his chance to post his first win of the season. He settled midfield on the markers, was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished nicely for fourth behind Hot Deal in the open class event at Mildura last week. MIDNIGHT PIRATE (2) was resuming since May when he pushed forward to park without cover and battled on strongly for fourth behind Lewielewis last week. He should be fitter and is a fast beginner so a bold showing is expected. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6) is racing very consistently and is likely to be hitting the line strongly. She missed out narrowly in the race won by Lewielewis last week. CHEERS POVERTY (3) performs best when he is able to lead and his chances of winning will be enhanced if he can get across to the markers on the first turn. BACK: MY ULTIMATE BILLY (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE BILLY (5), MIDNIGHT PIRATE (2), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (6), CHEERS POVERTY (3)

OVERVIEW:LUVTOBEUPTOME (7) is a quality colt, which was taken up to Queensland for a Winter Carnival campaign then followed with his three sound performances during the Super Series, where sixth in the Final from a poor draw. He is clearly the class runner of the field and will take plenty of beating. DON CRUNCH (4) has been driven aggressively at his past two attempts, which yielded a strong victory over JUST INCREDIBLE (3) and a brave third (neck) behind Lewielewis. He has only missed a place once in eight starts to date and should run his usual honest race. THE GOLDEN HOOK (6) delivered clearly a career best performance when he worked to the front at Gawler, ran along at a rapid rate and scored by ten lengths! He is poorly drawn but a repeat performance should see him being competitive. JUST INCREDIBLE (3) worked very hard early and had excuses last outing. He is worth thought in multiple combinations along with LISTEN TO THE HAND (5), which led throughout for an impressive win in South Australia last outing. BACK: LUVTOBEUPTOME (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LUVTOBEUPTOME (7), DON CRUNCH (4), THE GOLDEN HOOK (6), JUST INCREDIBLE (3)

OVERVIEW: PUNTO CALIENTE (9) produced a big finish when second behind FLEUR BELLA (8) at Mildura two weeks ago then followed with a fourth behind Ned’s Beach last week. This race is of similar standard and he should be finding the line strongly again. FLEUR BELLA (8) led throughout and won easily at Mildura two starts ago then disappointed after enjoying a good run in the leading role at Charlton. She tends to perform best at Mildura and is worth another chance. KEAYANG CRIPPA (4) didn’t run on as expected last week but he had to be driven along early to try and hold a forward position from the inside draw. His form prior was sound and a better performance is expected here. KEILAH (7) has been racing well in South Australia and scored in a mile of 1.57.1 when coming from the back at Port Pirie last outing. She is awkwardly drawn but is not without a chance. SELECTIONS: PUNTO CALIENTE (9), FLEUR BELLA (8), KEAYANG CRIPPA (4), KEILAH (7)

OVERVIEW: CELESTIAL NEBULAE (6) is the class runner and continues to race in great form having had two wins and two seconds from his past four attempts. He gave the leaders a big start and charged into an eye-catching second last week so he is capable of going better now. PERFECT GAMBLE (4) is a South Australian trained mare, which was placed twice at Globe Derby prior to a fifth at Port Pirie, where she endured a tough run after over-racing on the outside of the leader. She is a fast beginner and should give a forward showing under these conditions. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (5) battled on fairly well after racing without cover throughout at his latest third placed effort. He has won twice at Mildura since coming from Western Australia and is worth thought from his front row draw. MY ULTIMATE HENRY (3) led throughout at a Mildura victory on August 14. He is a 2yo taking on older horses but will be suited over the sprint distance and is not without a chance. BACK: CELESTIAL NEBULAE (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: CELESTIAL NEBULAE (6), PERFECT GAMBLE (4), CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (5), MY ULTIMATE HENRY (3)

OVERVIEW: Wide-open start to the night where I think THESTATESMAN (3) gets his chance to show us how he’s really going. He has seemingly been running okay from unsuitable positions in transit for some time, including last Saturday night when he settled near last and held his own in an on-pace dominated race. He draws to work forward and find the fence, and from there should run well. He’s by no means a moral, with a host of other winning chances. The talented ZENARIO (9) looks sure to fight out the finish from the nice back row alley, HITTHEROADJACK (6) is likely to be sent forward in a bid to find the front and is a one-paced horse who would be a big threat if he was able to control things at the top, while MITZI SAID (8) looks one that will bob up at odds in the near future when things pan out to suit. She’s been running home nicely of late and just needs the breaks to go her way. SEA FURY (11) can be forgiven for the first-up effort after getting caught parked there at Geelong, IMA TERMINATOR (4) and CAPTAIN PINS (10) are threats with the right trip and noting a small ownership share in TIMBIMBOO (5), who is first-up and will likely need the run. BACK: THESTATESMAN (3) – 1 unit (each-way) SELECTIONS: THESTATESMAN (3), ZENARIO (9), HITTHEROADJACK (6), MITZI SAID (8)

OVERVIEW: MAXIMEZ (9) was first-up from a break in a race four of these horses contested last week at Ballarat and he only went down narrowly in a photo after racing in the chair for the last lap. It was a good performance after a stint away from the races, and from the nice back row draw he looks to be one of the leading contenders. AMOUR MATERNAL (1) settled three fence and charged late to run third there, and while she rarely wins, draws for another economical trip on the pegs. She’s sure to be closing hard and can prevail if the breaks come her way. South Australian visitor IDEOLOGY (4) has made breaks in both starts here in Victoria – including last week at Ballarat when he hit the front in the straight – but had a big picket fence going before that, and TICTOK (10) is running consistently well of late and is among the other chances headed by LORD LOGAN (7), OX KNOX (5) and WALLIS (6). SELECTIONS: MAXIMEZ (9), AMOUR MATERNAL (1), IDEOLOGY (4), TICTOK (10)

OVERVIEW: BLAZIN BY (4) won first-up this campaign and has run a couple of great races in defeat since then. Last time, he ripped home in a slick last half at Ballarat to just miss Posterized in a photo and before that was only beaten 4.6m at Kilmore by Owen The Saints, who has won again since. Happy in his corner. WEONA OUR RIGHTS (2) was outclassed in a heat of the Vicbred series but has run good placings in his other three starts this campaign and draws gate one if the emergency fails to gain a start, GIVE FRED A CLAP (7) did plenty wrong at Shepparton last time but still got up to win and is a factor despite the wide gate, while TED BEAR (3) closed off nicely from back in the field to win an easier race at Ballarat last week and heads a few others that could prevail without completely surprising such as OUR BELLA LUCIA (5), ALL THINGS SPICY (6) and LENARD ESS (8). BACK: BLAZIN BY (4) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: BLAZIN BY (4), WEONA OUR RIGHTS (2), GIVE FRED A CLAP (7), TED BEAR (3)

OVERVIEW: This is the sole heat of the Need For Speed Princess series for three-year-old trotting fillies, which leads to a Group 1 final at Melton on October 10. HALLEBESOFINE (2) draws to find the front and based off her recent efforts, she looks the one to beat. She worked to the top and boxed on bravely for second in the Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final last time out, beating home five rivals that reoppose here. Before that, she won a heat in dominant fashion and has been in great form this entire campaign. JILLIBY AURA (4) led and won another heat of that Vicbred series in good style and then raced in the breeze when fifth in the final behind Queen Of Sees. There’s a chance she launches to the fence early and would be a genuine threat from there. HARPERSEVEN (5) finished second to JILLIBY AURA (4) in the qualifier and ran well from back in the field in the final, as did MAJESTIC YANKEE (6), who is only an outside winning hope but one to consider for trifectas and First 4s along with ALDEBARAN ADA (8), IJUSTCANTSEEIT (1), last-start Vicbred Silver winner ZOOLU (3) and even MEVIA (10). BACK: HALLEBESOFINE (2) – 4 units SELECTIONS: HALLEBESOFINE (2), JILLIBY AURA (4), HARPERSEVEN (5), MAJESTIC YANKEE (6)

OVERVIEW: TIVOLI (8) reached the final of the Vicbred Super Series for four-year-old mares, and while she was ultimately well held there, she ran okay in a heat when fifth behind Let Her Roll at Kilmore. Her effort prior at Melton in a stronger race than this was very good when she came from last to finish third to Scooter Lou, and this looks a suitable grade for her. She draws to trail fast beginner FROSTY DROP (1), who has led a couple of times in recent starts over the longer trip and only been run down late. She can hold the top here and the drop back to 1720m might be telling. TRYX VIXEN (3) was a bit plain despite a good draw in the Vicbred Silver final last time out but can improve back into this grade, while BLACKINDEED (7) might be next best and heads here for a first-up assignment following a runner-up placing at the Melton trials behind smart two-year-old Comeandsee. BACK: TIVOLI (8) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: TIVOLI (8), FROSTY DROP (1), TRYX VIXEN (3), BLACKINDEED (7)

OVERVIEW: First heat of the Need For Speed Prince for the three-year-old trotting boys which leads to a Group 1 final on October 10 and UNCLAD (2) gets the marginal nod from the good gate. He was the clear standout of the four horses that clashed in the Vicbred Super Series final on September 12, bursting clear from four back the fence approaching the turn and rattling into second behind Howdy Mate. He should get to the pegs, and from in front or behind the leader he will be very hard to hold out. MUNNY THE MUNSTER (3) was caught parked in that Vicbred decider but ran a good race to only be beaten 14.9m, and would be tough to chase down if he got the top. MISTER DEVEREAUX (8) is a top trotter on the rise, and while he didn’t have much chance from a horror draw in that Vicbred final, he cut ground off Pastor Dunbar when second in his heat in what was a much better run than UNCLAD (2) on his back. THE PREACHER (6) is the other key winning hope, but unless he can cross to the fence, it might be too hard from gate six. SELECTIONS: UNCLAD (2), MUNNY THE MUNSTER (3), MISTER DEVEREAUX (8), THE PREACHER (6)

OVERVIEW: Second heat of the Need For Speed Prince and here we see the return of KYVALLEY RAY (7) to Victorian racing. He has proven a star in New Zealand by winning three Group 1 races and steps out for his first start since May. To be honest, I’d like to have seen a bit more from him in three trials at Melton, but he goes on top based on what he’s done so far in his career. Do I want to take likely short odds about him? Probably not, but he’s the one to beat. TIMMY WHIZ (2) has the gate speed to lead and gripped on to finish third in the Group 1 Vicbred final behind Howdy Mate last time out, REVERAND BOB (3) went rough when seemingly in a striking position last week at Ballarat but has been very competitive in most of his starts this campaign, while ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1) got the perfect run to beat MUSCLE VALLEY (8) at the same meeting and draws for a lovely trip on the fence. PASS THE SALT (5), who was a good second in the Vicbred Silver at Bray Raceway, and HAMMER (6), who trailed okay behind Pastor Dunbar at Shepparton ahead of this first-up run, are the other outside hopes. SELECTIONS: KYVALLEY RAY (7), TIMMY WHIZ (2), REVERAND BOB (3), ITZ CLASSIC GOLD (1)

OVERVIEW: JUSTLIKEDAVE (6) rattled home from an impossible position for an eye-catching runner-up placing at Ballarat on August 26, and then worked to the front and bolted in by 18.6m in decent time at Cranbourne latest. He’s the horse in form and I’m very happy his way. BACKBEACH PETER (8) heads across the border from South Australia on the back of a trial win at Mount Gambier, and while he hasn’t beaten a horse home in his last three outings, he has ability and warrants respect, CINQUANTA (3) had every chance last time when leading at Kilmore but is working towards a victory, while ROSBERG (7) won a similar race to this at Melton back on August 7 and has been a bit outclassed in his subsequent assignments. He certainly wouldn’t shock. BACK: JUSTLIKEDAVE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: JUSTLIKEDAVE (6), BACKBEACH PETER (8), CINQUANTA (3), ROSBERG (7)

OVERVIEW: ELLEEGANT LANE (7) absolutely bolted in at Melton two starts ago on September 9 and was caught in the breeze before fading late into third last time out at Shepparton. All her recent form is solid and she goes on top despite the wide front row gate. PRECIOUS BELLE (8) chased gallantly for second to the in-form Blue Miki recently at Melton and has good closing speed in this grade, THE BLAZINBOOTS (5) has run two very good second placings at Terang and Stawell leading into this and looks ready to break through with the right trip, while MIDNIGHT MOJO (4) is a consistent type who is a chance like most of these with some luck in transit. SELECTIONS: ELLEEGANT LANE (7), PRECIOUS BELLE (8), THE BLAZINBOOTS (5), MIDNIGHT MOJO (4)

OVERVIEW: ITSAWOMANSWORLD (5) was fancied on debut at Cranbourne on the back of some good trials, but was caught parked and ultimately galloped out of contention in the last lap. That race was won by the smart Twigstar, who she had previously beaten at the trials. In a wide-open clash, she looks likely to run well. CAPTAIN HANK (3) heads here on debut for Joe Pace and won a Melton trial on September 8 before a sound third placing last time out, the Jess Tubbs-trained SANDELTON (1) is another stepping out at the races for the first time on the back of some solid trial efforts, while SWEET FLORABEL (7) has done plenty wrong in her races to date but has good ability and a flawless display could see her winning a race like this. PERFECT FEELING (2) has good gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position in this race form a good draw. He can get a touch keen in his races which could make things tricky for him over the 2040 journey. ROYAL WINKLE (3) should settle close in the run from a good draw in this race. He wasn’t beaten far in fifth last time out at Redcliffe. He should be running on late. TRACER BULLET (5) secured a good run close to the speed last time out and was closing off strongly to be narrowly beaten by Teachers Pet. He should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. DIAMOND DEANO (7) loves to race on the pegs and should get that opportunity in this race. He wasn’t beaten far last time out in a strong race taken out by Its One Life. SELECTIONS: PERFECT FEELING (2), ROYAL WINKLE (3), TRACER BULLET (5), DIAMOND DEANO (7) SUGGESTED BET: TRACER BULLET (5) to win.

LUVATINNY (1) has drawn poorly in two starts for the Dixon stable and gets a good opportunity to find the front early this time. She was closing off nicely first up when the race wasn’t run to suit and should be close to peaking third up. FLORAS FOLLY (7) should get a good run through early behind the likely leader in this race. She was forced to do the work outside the leader last time out which probably isn’t a position she is ideally suited to and was able to battle on well for third. PICCOLO DIAVOLO (5) is likely to be shuffled back from the wide draw in this race. He was shuffled back last time out and hit the line nicely late to get into second behind Carly Perez. JUSTANOTHER TORQUE (8) took on a much stronger race last time out taken out by Prince Naseem and did well to battle away for fifth not beaten too far. She looks likely to get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: LUVATINNY (1), FLORAS FOLLY (7), PICCOLO DIAVOLO (5), JUSTANOTHER TORQUE (8) SUGGESTED BET: LUVATINNY (1) to win.

TWIN CITIES (1) has good gate speed and can look to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race from an ideal draw. She led last time out and may have just found the 2040 journey a touch too far there at Redcliffe. DIVINE ABUNDANCE (8) led recently at this track and seemed to get quite keen out in front when run down in the concluding stages by Cobbity Cadence who was able to secure the perfect run on her back. She should get an economical run and looks a chance in this race. AIRFORCE ONE (9) was good in collectively much stronger races his first two outings at Albion Park. He appears well suited in this race and appears to find a reasonably suitable draw in this race to do no work early. MCROCKIN (7) has had her chance to break maiden status a few times in her 12 start career and probably bumps into a few which she may just find a touch too good. She looks likely to secure a good run and should be thereabouts the minor money. SELECTIONS: TWIN CITIES (1), DIVINE ABUNDANCE (8), AIRFORCE ONE (9), MCROCKIN (7) SUGGESTED BET: TWIN CITIES (1) to win.

ONE CHAIN ROAD (9) has excellent gate speed which usually sees him prominent in the run. Having drawn on the back row in this race he gets an opportunity to have sat up and we should see him using his high speed to get into the race late. DIGBY DEVIL (6) was forced to race without cover last time out at Albion Park when battling on nicely there to fill a minor placing. This draw appears quite awkward again on paper and he may be shuffled back or forced to do some work at some stage. ITS ONE LIFE (3) doesn’t have brilliant gate speed but finds a race without an abundance of early speed which could see him drive through and lead. He was able to secure the leaders back trail last time out and was far too strong there. LAST CALL (7) draws awkwardly inside the back row in this race and will need luck at the right time to get into the clear. She wasn’t suited last time out in a race taken out by Doo Don’t Think. SELECTIONS: ONE CHAIN ROAD (9), DIGBY DEVIL (6), ITS ONE LIFE (3), LAST CALL (7) SUGGESTED BET: ONE CHAIN ROAD (9) to win.

STILLYOURSHOT (1) has been close to a win without quite having been able to break through. He should be able to drive through and lead early in this race and should be very hard to run down from that position. CEDAR CREEK FALLS (7) should get a good run through behind the leader in this race which is a position she loves to race in. She ran on nicely late last start into third behind Francs For Coming. MISS SYRAH (9) was running on well last time out behind Sheer Vitality. She should get a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on late. FAVREAU (4) got back in the run last time out over the 2040 at this track and was running on late in a race taken out by John Wayne. He should settle close from a good draw and should be running on late. SELECTIONS: STILLYOURSHOT (1), CEDAR CREEK FALLS (7), MISS SYRAH (9), FAVREAU (4) SUGGESTED BET: STILLYOURSHOT (1) to win.

MALARKY (2) has some gate speed and may be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. She has led and won previously at this track and trip and should be hard to run down off the back of a good fourth last time out at Albion Park. KEAYANG MOSCATO (10) was able to lead and score a good win last time out at this track. She gets less favours this time from the back row draw in this race and may be forced to work at some stage. MAGICOL IDEAL (7) draws awkwardly inside the back row but should find this a lot easier than some of his recent outings and is suited by a soft run in his races usually. He drew poorly last time out in a race taken out by Loch Lamond at Albion Park and couldn’t get into it there. ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (3) led last time out and ran out a dominant winner taking them all the way. She draws outside of a horse this time which may be keen to lead which could be a touch tricky for her. SELECTIONS: MALARKY (2), KEAYANG MOSCATO (10), MAGICOL IDEAL (7), ITS BACK PAGE NEWS (3) SUGGESTED BET: MALARKY (2) to win.
